headword: {近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる
gloss: rarely seen in recent years; unprecedented in modern times; remarkable (used to modify a noun)

definitions.gloss: rarely seen in recent years; unprecedented in modern times; remarkable (used to modify a noun)
definitions.explanation: Functions as a pre-noun modifier. Often used in news reporting and formal writing to emphasize the exceptional nature of something.

examples.japanese: {近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a heavy snowfall rarely seen in recent years.

examples.japanese: {近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる⟦{好成績|こうせいせき}→好成績：24101_kouseiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: They achieved results rarely seen in recent years.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This film is regarded as a masterpiece rarely seen in recent years.

notes:
An expression combining ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧ (recent years), ⟦{稀|まれ}→稀：00269_mare⟧ (rare), and みる (to see/find). Functions as a pre-noun modifier meaning "of a kind rarely seen in recent years," emphasizing that something is exceptionally good, bad, or unusual compared to the recent past.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる + [exceptional noun]: modifies nouns describing extreme events or achievements
- {近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる{大|おお}〜: rarely-seen great/large ~
- {近年稀|きんねんまれ}にみる{好|こう}〜: rarely-seen good ~

USAGE:
Can modify both positive and negative nouns:
- Positive: ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧ (masterpiece), ⟦{好成績|こうせいせき}→好成績：24101_kouseiseki⟧ (good results), ⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧ (good harvest)
- Negative: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧ (heavy snow), ⟦{不作|ふさく}→不作：18799_fusaku⟧ (bad harvest), ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (extreme heat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ない→見る：00283_miru⟧: unparalleled, without parallel
- ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧: unprecedented, unheard of
- ⟦{空前|くうぜん}→空前：22320_kuuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: unprecedented
